trust_decision.summary: Whether an untrusted (multi-user server) uploaded agent bundle may declare a server-runtime tool whose path is a dotted Python import that the runner imports and invokes; decided once at the upload boundary in validate_agent_bundle, gated on enforce_handler_allowlist (= not local_single_user_enabled()).

landing_point.why: Summary says 'uploaded agent bundle'; validate_agent_bundle is the single upload validator and already hosts the sibling guards (handler allowlist, os_env.cwd) at omnigent/server/bundles.py:96-108.

fix_sites.module_kind: server upload validator (shared helper); fix adds _is_dotted_callable_path + recursive _reject_uploaded_callable_tools in the same file (fix.diff:17-58)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Published fix touches only omnigent/server/bundles.py (fix.diff:5-109); all three upload routes funnel through it.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 routes: 'the server already validated the bundle at upload' (omnigent/runner/_entry.py:646-652 says so explicitly) and 'tool callables are only imported, not invoked, at parse time' (omnigent/inner/loader.py:124-126).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Bundled tools/python/*.py file tools (path 'tools/python/x.py', runtime SERVER by default) must keep working; Unity Catalog function tools carry a dotted three-level catalog_path with path=None; client-runtime tools have path=None; a trusted local single-user server must still accept callable: tools. A guard that rejects every SERVER tool, or any dotted string, or ignores the trust gate breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: top-level omnigent YAML tools: entry with type: function + callable: (type defaults to function, runtime defaults to server: omnigent/inner/loader.py:371-389)
callable tool inside an inline AgentTool sub-agent and nested sub-sub-agents (omnigent/spec/omnigent.py:1101-1117, 1414-1430), handled by recursion over spec.sub_agents (fix.diff:57-58)
tools: self clone sub-agent (omnigent/spec/omnigent.py:1091-1100), covered by the same recursion

O7_producer.where: omnigent/spec/omnigent.py:1956-1962 (_translate_function_tool_from_def stamps runtime=SERVER and path recovered from the resolved callable's __module__.__qualname__, omnigent/spec/omnigent.py:2002-2005); upstream the inner loader imports the callable at parse time, omnigent/inner/loader.py:389-401

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Single-file omnigent YAML upload: the inner loader imports the attacker-named callable: module on the server during validate_agent_bundle, before the post-parse guard runs (policy handlers are pre-scanned, tool callables explicitly are not).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Import is not invocation; loader docstring says tool callables 'are not invoked at parse time' (omnigent/inner/loader.py:124-126).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: omnigent/inner/ package, 2 hops below the landing point (bundles.py -> spec/__init__.py:285-291 -> inner/loader.py)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Execution-time loads of stored bundles (runner spec resolver and server AgentCache) never apply the callable guard, so a bundle stored before the fix (or any stored session-scoped bundle) still reaches the runner import+invoke sink.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Comment states the server already validated the bundle before serving it; stored bundles only arrive through validated upload routes (other artifact_store.put callers are built-ins/CLI: omnigent/server/app.py:354, 371; omnigent/cli.py:1048, 1065).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: omnigent/runner/ and omnigent/runtime/agent_cache.py:94, other packages from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Runner-side callable resolver that should refuse dotted callables for session-scoped specs (X-Agent-Session-Scoped already reaches the runner, omnigent/runner/_entry.py:639-640).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The runner already makes a per-bundle trust decision for env expansion from the same header; a maintainer adding defence-in-depth would put the callable gate there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Second implementation of dotted-path import+invoke (LocalCallableTool._ensure_loaded) selected by language, not runtime (omnigent/tools/local_callable.py:247-255).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Real distinct implementation in another package doing the same job; a planted copy of the guard there would be natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Identity differential: the guard treats any path ending in .py/.ts or containing '/' as a file tool, while the runner splits with rpartition('.') (omnigent/runner/tool_dispatch.py:577) and the file/dotted test at omnigent/runner/app.py:6239-6255 differs (os.sep); a recovered path like 'pkg.mod.py' (attribute named py) passes the guard yet imports pkg.mod.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Structural heuristics are duplicated in three places with slightly different rules; a language-based check (OMNIGENT_TOOL_LANGUAGE) would be the robust form.

O9_family: CWE-94 code injection: untrusted declarative config selects an arbitrary importable callable that the runner imports and invokes (unsafe dynamic dispatch / missing trust-boundary check)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/server/test_bundles.py (upload validator, incl. handler-allowlist callable alias test at line 219), tests/tools/test_local_callable.py, tests/runner/test_tool_dispatch_timer.py

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject every local tool with runtime SERVER (or any dotted string) at the top level only, which breaks bundled tools/python files / UC tools and misses inline sub-agent tools.

out_of_scope_notes: Uploaded bundles can ship tools/python/*.py files and stdio MCP servers that execute bundle-supplied code/commands on the runner by design (omnigent/runner/tool_dispatch.py:4056-4065); different mechanism, not pursued.
Omnigent-YAML handler allowlist scans only top-level policies: (omnigent/inner/loader.py:139-154); separate protection (handler allowlist), not pursued.
